payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort pairs (index, height) by height, then greedily partition into maximal blocks by tracking the farthest original index in each sorted prefix.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts with a custom key (height), then uses index mappings to determine block boundaries where the maximum original index in the current sorted prefix equals the current index, a classic O(n log n) approach for 'max chunks to make sorted II'.
